note: Synthetic registry for the Acme ISD fixture district. Demonstrates the inventory shape a real district would maintain, including one entry deliberately left unapproved and one deliberately classified prohibited.

systems.name: District Knowledge Assistant
systems.purpose: Answer staff and public questions from approved district policy, regulation, and handbook content.
systems.affected_population: All district staff and members of the public using the district website.
systems.human_oversight: Answers are advisory and carry citations plus a contact-staff disclosure. No decision is taken by the system.

systems.name: IT Operations Assistant
systems.purpose: Help technology staff find SOPs, infrastructure documentation, and troubleshooting steps.
systems.human_oversight: Read-only guidance; a technician performs every action.

systems.name: Counselor Caseload Assistant
systems.purpose: Help counselors locate accommodation documentation for students on their caseload.
systems.affected_population: Students with Section 504 plans at participating campuses.
systems.human_oversight: Counselor reviews every retrieved record; the system makes no eligibility or placement determination.

systems.name: Composite Student Risk Scoring (rejected)
systems.purpose: Proposed system to rank students by composite risk from attendance, discipline, and behaviour data.
systems.human_oversight: Not applicable; registration refused at screening.
systems.rejection_reason: Matched prohibited-use control PU-SOCIAL-SCORING. A composite behavioural score used to allocate services or scrutiny is the district-flavoured form of social scoring. Retained in the inventory as evidence that the screening control fired -- rejected systems are not deleted from the registry.
